raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-KHM-BasicEducationImprovement",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Climate hazards such as severe flooding, tropical cyclones, and extreme heat pose major risks of damaging school infrastructure and disrupting primary education continuity.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Incorporate climate-resilient designs, elevated foundations, natural ventilation, and solar panels into infrastructure, and deploy e-learning platforms for education continuity.",
      "evidence": "Natural disasters caused by climate change, including floods, cyclones, and extreme heat, pose significant challenges for Cambodia, particularly affecting the continuity of education."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Overloaded financial management staff at the Directorate General of Administration and Finance could lead to delays in processing transactions and financial reporting.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Appoint additional adequate financial management staff, including government officers and external consultants, within three months of project signing.",
      "evidence": "The current FM staff at the Directorate General of Administration and Finance may be overloaded, potentially leading to delays in processing transactions and reporting."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Delays in approving the Annual Work Plan and Budget (AWPB) may hinder the timely execution of planned project activities.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Adopt a simplified AWPB template and clear approval guidelines integrated into the Project Operations Manual and Financial Management Manual.",
      "evidence": "The delayed approval of the Annual Work Plan and Budget (AWPB) may hinder the timely implementation of project activities."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Decentralized school mentoring funding disbursed directly to cluster lead primary schools risks inadequate monitoring and improper expenditure tracking.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Formulate and enforce explicit guidelines on School Mentoring Funding within the Project Operations Manual and Financial Management Manual.",
      "evidence": "There is a risk that school mentoring funding, which is to be spent at the schools, may not be properly monitored."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "MoEYS staff's limited familiarity with World Bank Procurement Regulations could cause project implementation delays and noncompliance.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Assign full-time government procurement officers to the project and provide targeted contract management training from the World Bank.",
      "evidence": "MoEYS staff’s limited knowledge and experience with the World Bank’s Procurement Regulations, potentially resulting in project implementation delays and noncompliance"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Late provision of technical inputs from implementing departments risks delaying procurement processes and contract awards.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Appoint dedicated focal points across technical departments and set clear service standards in the Project Operations Manual.",
      "evidence": "possible delays in receiving technical inputs for procurement"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Governance risks including potential corrupt practices during procurement could compromise procurement integrity and resource allocation.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Mandate enhanced publication of procurement plans and contract awards, establish a procurement complaint handling mechanism, and enforce rigorous monitoring.",
      "evidence": "governance risks, including corrupt practices in procurement"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Weak capacity for contract supervision and management may cause implementation delays and substandard civil works or procurement delivery.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Deliver targeted contract management training to the procurement team and institute procurement tracking forms with delegated authority levels.",
      "evidence": "inadequate capacity for contract supervision and management, which may result in implementation delays"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Bottlenecks and delayed internal clearances from the Procurement Review Committee may impede timely contract execution.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Establish service standard timelines in the Project Operations Manual and delegate appropriate review authority to committee members.",
      "evidence": "possible delays in internal clearance from procurement review committee."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Phase 2 development of the modernized HRMIS may fail or stall if Phase 1 deliverables fail to meet technical, regulatory, or sustainability requirements.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Conduct thorough stakeholder consultations, system scoping, and function mapping during Phase 1 prior to inviting bids for Phase 2 system development.",
      "evidence": "Progression to Phase 2 is conditional on Phase 1 results demonstrating quality and feasibility in terms of (a) technical and system development"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Scaling Early Grade Learning (EGL) programs from localized donor initiatives to full nationwide government implementation risks loss of fidelity due to technical and capacity constraints.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Apply an implementation science-informed learning agenda with rapid testing, mixed-methods process evaluations, and continuous feedback to adapt implementation.",
      "evidence": "Transitioning from successful, donor-funded interventions with limited geographic coverage to implementation at scale through government systems requires overcoming the many technical, financial, political economy, and capability constraints"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Severe classroom overcrowding affects student learning and restricts teachers' ability to manage instruction and monitor performance.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Construct climate-resilient additional classrooms targeted at overcrowded primary schools with class sizes of 50 or more students.",
      "evidence": "overcrowded classrooms is prevalent in Cambodian schools, with 76 percent of primary students learning in classes with more than 30 students... affecting student learning."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Lack of affordable, quality childcare services creates significant caregiving barriers that restrict women's formal employment participation and productivity.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Establish approximately 60 public childcare centers co-located with existing preschools near industrial and garment hubs, and evaluate impact on female employment.",
      "evidence": "Gendered care responsibilities, particularly the lack of accessible childcare, further restrict women’s opportunities to formal sector work"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Widespread low baseline proficiency in reading and math among primary students threatens the achievement of primary education development objectives.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Deploy structured Early Grade Learning (EGL) packages nationwide, introduce targeted remedial instruction (TaRL), and scale up school readiness programs.",
      "evidence": "in a national assessment conducted in 2021, 81 percent of Grade 6 students did not reach the proficient level in math and Khmer."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "The project faces substantial environmental and social risks related to land acquisition, indigenous populations, cultural heritage, and infrastructure construction.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Implement the ESMF, ESCP, IPPF, universal design standards for accessibility, and a specialized SEA/SH grievance redress mechanism.",
      "evidence": "Environmental and Social Risk Classification: Substantial"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R16",
      "description": "Phasing out of development partner funding for EGL by 2027 threatens the sustainability and M&E capacity of early grade learning reforms.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Institutionalize cluster lead school mentoring funding, integrate EGL into standard MoEYS operating budgets, and deploy the national PLP digital platform.",
      "evidence": "Their support is expected to phase out by 2027. Due to these one-off interventions, there are gaps in M&E"
    }
  ]
}
